hotels.title: Boutique Guernsey Escape near Saints Bay with Daily Breakfast & Daily Dining Credit
hotels.description: Tucked into a quiet green valley above Saints Bay, La Barbarie Hotel by Eight Continents is a charming boutique hotel that pairs country-house warmth with quiet grace. Expect comfortable rooms with a relaxed, old-world ambience, a cosy restaurant serving creative British dishes and fresh local seafood, plus a spacious sun terrace and flower-filled gardens made for slow afternoons between island adventures. In Guernsey’s parish of St Martin, this hideaway feels blissfully peaceful yet brilliantly placed for exploring the island’s wilder side. Saints Bay, Icart Point, dramatic cliff paths and the secluded coves of the south coast are all close by while St Peter Port is just a short drive away. This is the perfect base for coastal walks, scenic swims and days out across the Channel Islands.
